rule: car-1015-v2 (10-21, user: "보상 작은게 명확한 애들만 모아서 새로운 v2 데이터 만들자"): the car-1015-v1 exclusions (rule_v1 below) PLUS every episode that is not CLEARLY low gravity compensation. Clear low = the static-frame elbow residual (measured - commanded, both arms; playground/eval_results/gravity_comp_scan) > 0.4 deg in every available window (first 2 s / middle third / last 2 s; the low-compensation arm sags ~+1.6 deg, the high one sits ~-1.0 deg), and >= 2 windows OR a mean elbow residual >= 1.0 deg. 10-21 (user: "상향등 깜박임 버리고 와이퍼 순찰 1, 2, 3까지만 쓰자"): also every episode of task 7 (high-beam flash) and of the tasks left with 1-3 low-comp episodes: 6 (hazard lever), 8 (high beams off), 15 (menu Radio->InfoCon).
rule_v1: drop if duration < 0.5 x train median of its normalized task (car1015_task_map.json), or task in {0,1,4,5} (turn signal / center hazard) with no head look (|yaw cmd| > 20 deg for >= 0.5 s); plus (added 10-19 after the full train scan) dark head_left video (ep 14430 = v1 junk 237) and measured head state stuck at the sensor error value (-281.9, 309.5 deg); plus (10-19, "drop the weird ones" instead of repairing them) every episode with a hand-state row outside [-100, 2200] (sensor garbage), a teleop reset (an arm commanded to the all-zero home pose), or a 1-frame command spike (head or arm cmd jumps > 15 deg and is back within 8 deg 4 frames later). extra: category -> {train, val} ids
